description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Declaration of Kurunegala, Mawathagama and Polgahawela P/S areas to be Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of specific geographical areas (Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha Area and Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha Area) as urban development areas. It includes detailed metes and bounds descriptions of land boundaries, which falls under land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the core land declaration purpose, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government classification type.
